Chris,

Marvin Cohen here, closing coordinator at Everlight. Henry passed this one to me, and I've got a deal that matches your box exactly.

1298 Englewood St, Memphis 38107. Single family, 1912 build. Under contract right now. The appraisal came in at 38,400, and we're offering assignment for 21,120. That's your 55% all in number, no stretch.

Here's the timeline: we can have this to you as a clean assignment contract by end of business tomorrow. No contingencies on our side. We close in 7 to 10 days once you sign. Parcel 026032 00030 if you want to pull comps.

This one fits. Send me a reply if you want the contract docs, or ping me on my line and we'll walk it. I'll have the full package ready either way.

Marvin Cohen
Closing Coordinator, Everlight Ventures

Reply STOP to opt out of future deal notifications.

Chris,

Got your number. Here's where we land.

We're holding at 20,500. That's 53.4% of appraised value on a 1912 SFR that fits your box tight. You close cash, as is, no inspections, no appraisals, no agent drag. We handle title, any liens, tenant stuff if it's there. You're in and out in 21 days, not 32 sitting on market.

The gap between 20,500 and 19,120 is 1,380. Over a typical 30 day hold, that's less than half your monthly carrying cost on the next deal you buy. Clean close beats grinding another thousand.

I'm sending the contract over by end of day. If 20,500 works, sign and ping me back. If you want to talk through it, call the Memphis line and we'll settle it in five minutes.

Either way, we keep sending deals that match your 55% all in target. That's the promise.

Marvin Cohen
Closing Coordinator, Everlight Ventures

Reply STOP to opt out of future offers.
